_comment: The instrument of ADR-0046, committed. Until 2026-08-18 the mutation pass existed only as a
number in that ADR (Stryker 9.6.1, 2973 mutants, 60.78%, 2h35 on 2026-08-05) and as a command
someone had typed once. A ratchet you cannot re-run is not a ratchet, and a measurement whose
configuration lives nowhere is exactly the kind of unreproducible claim this project refuses
It mutates dist/ rather than src/ because the tests import dist/ — the same build the package
ships, so a killed mutant is a mutant killed in what users actually run.
NEVER A GATE (ADR-0046 decision 1): no threshold is configured, `break` is null, and CI does not
run this. A score in a manifest would be a verdict nobody re-derived, which is what ADR-0045
forbids — runward does not do to itself what it refuses from an operator.
